entries.speaker: Interrogation Room Guard
entries.en: Anyway, what brings you here? I thought[n]you were done with your business...

entries.speaker: Interrogation Room Guard
entries.en: Th-There'd be no reason for anyone else[n]to come down here!

entries.speaker: Akechi's Voice
entries.en: Yes, the guard will be one of ours. We'll[n]have to eliminate him after to destroy[n]the evidence though...

entries.speaker: Interrogation Room Guard
entries.en: O-Of course it's true! Is something the[n]matter?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It's Akechi-kun. He had to take a sudden[n]call, so he won't be able to make it down[n]today.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: You know... if you stay here, they'll likely[n]get rid of you to eliminate any evidence.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I suggest you go into hiding at once if[n]you value your life.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: And don't say a word of what transpired[n]here. Trust nobody. Forget this ever[n]happened.
